<!-- TaskFlow Employee Management System - Project Instructions -->

## Project Overview
A centralized employee management system built with React frontend and AWS serverless backend architecture.

## Key Features
- [x] Task management (CRUD, Kanban view)
- [x] Leave workflows (multi-level approval)
- [x] Role-based dashboards
- [x] File uploads with S3
- [x] Notifications via SNS
- [x] Cognito authentication
- [x] ML-powered recommendations via EC2 API
- [x] Optional: Google Calendar + Slack integrations

## Architecture
- Frontend: React with AWS Amplify hosting
- Backend: AWS Lambda + API Gateway
- Database: DynamoDB
- Authentication: AWS Cognito
- Storage: S3 for file uploads
- Notifications: SNS
- ML Processing: EC2 instances
- Infrastructure: AWS CDK
